{{Quote|You must go to the Chamber of Banishment in which she is imprisoned and defeat her. To enter that chamber, according to this scroll, you will need the Nightsister Key of Exile.|[[Rohak]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TNH" />}}
The '''Nightsister Key of Exile''' was required to access the [[Chamber of Banishment]] was located in the [[Nightsister Stronghold]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], homeworld of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].<ref name="SWG:TNH" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightsister Key of Exile appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Key of Exile was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>

In the game, the Key of Exile was depicted as a purple and silver [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]].<ref name="SWG:TNH" />
